title: SNAP Participation Varies Across States and D.C.
discussion_signal: The data relay compares FY2025 SNAP participation rates across states and D.C., highlighting large geographic and household-composition differences while leaving the reasons for those differences open.
linked_research_question: What geographic, demographic, and administrative conditions produce sharply different SNAP participation rates across states?
limits: Participation rate is not a direct measure of need or program effectiveness
Post does not establish causes of state differences
